integrity: All coefficient tests are exact integer checks; no sampling is used. The analytic reduction covers the full parameter cube. Bibliographic priority may need further investigation; no independent review or validation has been performed.
limitations: Only three independent Bernoulli coordinates and three nonnegative increasing functions. No result for general FKG measures, four coordinates, negative-valued functions, or four input functions. Reproducing the exact finite coefficient audit requires running the embedded standalone verifier.
title: Three-bit Sahi positivity for all increasing functions under product measures
